content:
The aryl bromide and tert-butyl chloroformate are not buyable (according to database). We need alternative leaves that are buyable.

tert-butyl chloroformate maybe not buyable but Boc anhydride is buyable. We can use Boc anhydride to carbamoylate the secondary amine directly (forming Boc carbamate). That is a standard reaction: treat amine with Boc anhydride to give carbamate. So we can replace tert-butyl chloroformate with Boc anhydride (SMILES "C(C)(C)C(=O)OC(=O)C(C)(C)C").

Check buyability.
Let's call is_buyable for Boc anhydride.
